newsitem.title: ITALY: CIR shares slide after Cerus weakness.
newsitem.headline: CIR shares slide after Cerus weakness.

text.p: Shares in Carlo De Benedetti's family holding group CIR slipped after the fall on the Paris bourse of Cerus shares, in which CIR holds a 49 percent stake.

Cerus fell in Paris after French industrial group CGIP denied on Tuesday it planned to launch a takeover bid for the French holding group, but French newspapers quoted CGIP chairman saying that the company was interested in the 28 percent of French car parts group Valeo which Cerus holds.
"The denial of CGIP over a takeover of Cerus is penalising both the French shares and CIR," said one trader.
In Milan, CIR shares slipped 5.23 percent to a day's low of 680 lire before steadying to show losses of 1.74 percent at 705 at 1435 GMT. Cerus shares were off eight francs at 125 francs.
